title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00102 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: R/b stand of DP. Broke connection w/ 150knm. Inspect TDS after milling operation. Broke saversub w/ 100knm
00:45 - 01:30: M/u saversub to TDS. R/b stand of DP
01:30 - 02:45: POOH w/ milling BHA to surface, inspect same, cleaned magnets, 6 kg metal recovered from magnet fine swarf). Some wear observed on the cutting faces of mill
02:45 - 03:45: M/u BHA w/ new milling assembly
03:45 - 04:15: M/u 2ea stands of DP, m/u TDS, established circulation
04:15 - 12:00: Milling out 10 3/4in casing hanger. 100-120 RPM 1-3 wob, 2000 LPM, 3-11 KNM, 5-7 bar string stalled out several times 24knm. overpull to free pipe. Milled from 140. 98m to 141. 10m. Very slow progress
12:00 - 14:45: Continued milling out 10 3/4in casing hanger. 100-120 RPM 1-3 wob, 2000 LPM, 3-11 KNM, 5-7 bar string stalled out several times 24knm. overpull to free pipe. Milled from 141. 10m to 141. 23m. Improved progress. Got traces of h2s of 12 ppm
14:45 - 16:15: Picked of bttm and circulated clean while discussing way forward. Data indicated that mill has passed the hanger, estimated 20cm below planned milling depth, it was decided to POOH w/ milling BHA and attempt to pull CSG
16:15 - 16:30: Performed pre-job meeting
16:30 - 17:00: Unable to break out connection. Broke out double and layed out same.
17:00 - 17:15: Drop check on TDS
17:15 - 18:15: POOH from 110m to 12 m, all connections over torqued
18:15 - 18:30: Pulled mill and magnet assy, 1,5kg fine swarf recovered from magnets. Cleaned magnets, checked mill in gauge, observed normal wear on cutting faces
18:30 - 18:45: Layed out mill assy to deck
18:45 - 19:00: Cleaned and cleared rig floor
19:00 - 19:15: Performed pre-job meeting prior to p/u BHA
19:15 - 21:00: M/u spear BHA
21:00 - 21:30: RIH spear BHA on DP to 135m spear depth. L/d single for spaceout
21:30 - 21:45: M/u TDS to string. Recorded weights. Weight up 76t, weight down 74t, free rotation 75t, 3rpm, 0,5knm
21:45 - 22:15: RIH while pumping 300lpm. Tagged hange
